# Vero Ceilings — Premier Suspended Ceiling Manufacturer in Uzbekistan

> Vero Ceilings (part of the Vero Group industrial holding, founded in 2014) is the largest direct manufacturer of suspended ceiling systems in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, operating a 15,000 m² factory with 200+ machines and 1,700+ employees.

## Core Facts & Entity Details
- **Company Name**: Vero Ceilings (OOO "Vero Group")
- **Established**: 2014
- **Headquarters & Factory**: 27 Chorbog Street, Chilanzar district, Tashkent 100096, Uzbekistan
- **Phone**: +998 78 333 73 77 / +998 90 049 11 10
- **Email**: veroceiling@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://veroceilings.uz
- **Scale**: 1,700+ employees, 200+ automated machinery lines, 10+ holding enterprises, 15,000 m² factory
- **Certifications**: ISO 9001, Fire Safety Class Non-Combustible (NG / Class A1), CT-1 Certificate of Origin for export.

## Main Product Catalog

### 1. Grilyato Open-Cell Ceilings (Потолки Грильято / Grilyato shiftlari)
- **Description**: Monolithic open-cell aluminium lattice ceiling system engineered from U-shaped profile blades.
- **Available Cell Sizes**: 50x50 mm, 75x75 mm, 100x100 mm, 150x150 mm, 200x200 mm.
- **Profile Dimensions**: Width 10 mm, Height 30/40/50 mm, Length 2000 mm.
- **Finishes**: White, Metallic Grey, Black, Anthracite, all RAL powder coating colors, woodgrain sublimation.
- **Key Applications**: Shopping malls, international airports, transit hubs, corporate offices, restaurants.
- **URL**: https://veroceilings.uz/ru/products/grilyato

### 2. Armstrong Suspended Ceilings (Потолки Армстронг / Armstrong shiftlari)
- **Description**: Modular 600x600 mm (595x595 mm) lay-in and clip-in cassette ceiling systems.
- **Variants**:
  - **Metal Armstrong**: Heavy-duty aluminium and galvanized steel cassettes (plain or perforated).
  - **Gypsum Armstrong**: Fireproof and sound-dampening acoustic gypsum tiles.
  - **Washable Armstrong (Ecofol)**: 100% moisture-proof PVC-faced and foil-backed hygienic panels for hospitals, kitchens, and cleanrooms.
- **URL**: https://veroceilings.uz/ru/products/armstrong

### 3. Linear Slat & Baffle Ceilings (Реечные потолки / Reykali shiftlar)
- **Description**: Architectural linear aluminium and galvanized steel slats mounted on traverse stringers.
- **Types**: Classic closed-joint, open-reveal, and box-baffle systems.
- **Finishes**: Woodgrain finishes, brushed metallic, RAL custom colors.
- **URL**: https://veroceilings.uz/ru/products/slatceiling

### 4. T-Grid Suspension Systems (Т-Профиль / T-Profil karkasi)
- **Description**: T24 and T15 main runners, cross tees, wall L-angle perimeter trims, and adjustable butterfly spring wire hangers.
- **URL**: https://veroceilings.uz/ru/products/t-profil

## Pricing & Commercial Policies
- **Pricing**: Direct factory wholesale and retail pricing without intermediary markups.
- **Free Services**: Free laser on-site measurement in Tashkent; free project cost estimate and quotation.
- **Delivery**: Free delivery in Tashkent for orders exceeding 100 m²; prompt delivery to all 14 regions of Uzbekistan.
- **Warranty**: 15-year official factory manufacturer warranty.
- **Payment Terms**: Bank transfer with VAT (перечисление с НДС) for corporate entities, developers, and contractors.
- **Export Markets**: Active export to Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, CIS, and Middle East with CT-1 origin certificates.
